_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
login_to_continue: Main menu button, shown in place of Continue when signed out. Three words at most — the button does not grow.
continue: Main menu button, resumes the most recent game. Three words at most.
continue_tooltip: Tooltip on the Continue button. Two lines: the `\n` is deliberate. {{lastPlayed}} is a formatted date.
new_game: Main menu button. Three words at most.
new_game_error.title: Title of the dialog shown when creating a game fails. Atmospheric — the world speaks, not the software. One line, does not wrap.
new_game_error.message: Body of that dialog. Plain and factual, saying what happened and what to do. One or two sentences.
load_game: Main menu button, opens the Case files screen. Should match case_files.title.
decks: Main menu button. In-world word for decks; see the glossary.
settings: Main menu button, opens the settings dialog.
